title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Fully Exerting the Adjudicative Function to Provide Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Economic Development
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Fully Leveraging the Functions of Adjudication to Provide Judicial Guarantees and Legal Services for Economic Development

Fa Fa [2000] No. 6

At the crucial moment at the turn of the century, the Fourth Plenary Session of the 15th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Economic Work Conference made strategic arrangements for several major issues concerning the future and destiny of the country in the reform and development for the year 2000 and the coming period. People's courts at all levels across the country must follow the instruction of General Secretary Jiang Zemin to "strictly enforce the law and serve with enthusiasm," clearly recognize the situation and tasks, seize opportunities, forge ahead with determination, and unite in struggle to provide fair, efficient, and high-quality judicial guarantees and legal services for reform, opening up, and socialist modernization.

I. The Situation and Tasks Facing People's Courts

The Fourth Plenary Session of the 15th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Economic Work Conference proposed to continue implementing a proactive fiscal policy, leveraging the role of monetary policy, expanding domestic demand, accelerating the reform of state-owned enterprises, increasing the intensity of agricultural structural adjustment, implementing the strategy for large-scale development of the western region, actively expanding exports and utilizing foreign investment, and accelerating the implementation of economic development strategies such as revitalizing the country through science and education. With the implementation of these major decisions, the number of cases accepted by people's courts will maintain a relatively large increase over a longer period in the future, new types of cases will continue to emerge, and some unpredictable new situations and problems may arise in the legal enforcement environment. People's courts at all levels must have a clear understanding of this. To adapt to the profound changes in economic and social development, people's courts must accelerate reforms in trial methods, trial organization, trial management, internal institutions, and the personnel system, seeking efficiency from reform, promoting fairness through reform, and completing various adjudication and enforcement tasks with high quality and efficiency. The prospect of China's accession to the World Trade Organization (WTO) has become clear. Accession to the WTO marks a further expansion of China's opening up, engaging more deeply and comprehensively in international competition. While exercising the rights of a developing country, China will fulfill the obligations of WTO members and be bound by international economic and trade rules and international practices. Facing this major change and new challenges, people's courts must pay special attention to understanding and mastering the various operating rules of the WTO, analyzing and studying the hot spots and difficulties of future foreign-related economic dispute cases, and accordingly formulating judicial countermeasures, strengthening the training of expert judges, etc. These important tasks have been urgently and realistically placed before people's courts at all levels, and we must be adequately prepared ideologically, operationally, and organizationally. In terms of resolving contradictions among the people and maintaining social stability, the adjudication and enforcement work of people's courts faces many new and complex factors. During the process of deepening the reform of state-owned enterprises and rural reform, and carrying out industrial structural adjustments, there will still be social issues such as the living difficulties of laid-off workers, excessive burdens on farmers, and reduced income. Coupled with the incomplete establishment of social security mechanisms and the destructive impact of bureaucratic management and corruption phenomena such as embezzlement and bribery, new contradictions among the people may arise, some of which may seriously interfere with social stability. Leveraging the special role of judicial means to actively and steadily adjudicate and enforce cases involving contradictions among the people, especially group cases related to social security, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the people, and effectively eliminating factors of social instability, is the unshirkable major political task of people's courts and the most frequent, largest, and most fundamental judicial guarantee and legal service provided by people's courts for economic and social development.

The new trends in international human rights struggles have become a new issue that people's courts must pay attention to. Western countries, led by the United States, are accustomed to imposing their human rights standards as a precondition for economic exchanges and interfering in the internal affairs of other countries. After China's accession to the WTO, economic exchanges with Western countries will further expand and increase, and there will be many new changes in foreign-related civil, commercial, and criminal cases, some of which may become new pretexts for Western human rights interference. In adjudicating these cases, people's courts must always pay attention to properly balancing the relationship between developing international economic cooperation and maintaining national political and economic security, ensuring standardized procedures, substantive fairness, strict trial time limits, and effective enforcement. This will have a significant impact on further establishing China's good international image and improving the investment environment, as well as further enhancing the level of judicial protection of human rights, and its political and economic significance cannot be ignored.

At the turn of the century, people's courts must promptly seize the rare historical opportunity, courageously accept severe challenges from all sides, vigorously promote court reform, strive to solve the problem of the mismatch between the quality of judges and the level of justice with the needs of the situation and tasks, actively overcome various difficulties, and successfully advance the socialist people's judicial undertaking with Chinese characteristics.

II. Basic Principles That People's Courts Must Adhere to When Serving Economic Development

Since the reform and opening up, people's courts at all levels across the country have accumulated rich experience in serving the overall situation of reform, development, and stability, and have formed several basic principles that must be adhered to.

First, judicial fairness must be upheld. Judicial fairness is an essential requirement of adjudication, an important part of the basic strategy of governing the country according to law, the most fundamental requirement of the socialist market economy for judicial work, and the core and eternal theme of the work of people's courts. Adhering to the principle of judicial fairness means exercising the adjudicative and enforcement powers independently and fairly in accordance with the law, under the leadership of the Party and the supervision of the People's Congress, ensuring openness, fairness, and impartiality in both procedural and substantive aspects. With the development of the socialist market economy and accession to the WTO, the diversification of economic entities, the diversity of economic behaviors, and the independence of economic interests will further develop. This requires that people's courts, in their adjudication and enforcement work, always adhere to the principle of judicial fairness, maintaining the unity and dignity of national laws. Whether for the plaintiff or the defendant, whether for state-owned enterprises or other enterprises, whether for local parties or foreign parties, whether for Chinese parties or foreign parties, they must adhere to the principle that everyone is equal in the application of the law, and strictly and fairly adjudicate and enforce cases in accordance with the law.

Second, litigation efficiency must be improved and litigation costs reduced. Adapting to the laws of the market economy, effectively implementing the principle of litigation economy while ensuring case quality, can not only reduce the input of the case handling itself but also enable funds and materials tied up due to disputes to be quickly returned to normal circulation and utilization, and free up the involved personnel, thereby more effectively performing the function of adjudication work in serving economic development. To this end, it is necessary to further implement the principle of facilitating the people and facilitating litigation, properly carry out entrusted investigations, entrusted enforcement, and entrusted pronouncement of judgments in accordance with the law, properly apply the supervisory procedure, actively expand the scope of application of the summary procedure, try to reduce the litigation burden on the parties and the case handling pressure on the courts; fully implement the principle of mediation, fully respect the parties' right of disposition, shorten the litigation cycle, and minimize the negative impact on the commercial reputation and economic rights and interests of the parties; effectively strengthen trial management, improve case quality and efficiency, and minimize litigation and enforcement costs; in the reform of trial methods, while implementing the principle of openness to enable litigation participants to exercise their litigation rights in accordance with the law and ensure case quality, it is also necessary to reflect the principle of efficiency, prevent formalism and cumbersome philosophy, and actively explore and establish litigation mechanisms suitable for China's national conditions.

Third, adjudication must be based on strict law enforcement, and the functions of people's courts must be consciously exercised. As a state judicial organ, the people's court fulfills the function of ensuring and serving economic development mainly by independently and fairly exercising its adjudicative and enforcement powers in accordance with the law. People's courts must also complete the task of educating citizens to abide by socialist laws through all litigation activities conferred by law. Therefore, people's courts at all levels must strictly enforce the law and pay attention to the social effects of case handling. At the same time, they must, with a high sense of responsibility to the country and the people, through legal acceptance of cases, strengthening enforcement efforts, actively carrying out judicial suggestion activities, using various forms to explain the law through cases, actively participating in comprehensive management of social security, strengthening business guidance for grassroots mediation organizations, and boldly exploring other effective methods, actively provide multi-level, multi-faceted, high-quality, and efficient legal services for reform, development, and stability.

Fourth, all adjudication work must be comprehensively carried out closely around the overall situation. Serving the overall situation of reform, opening up, and economic construction is the guiding ideology and political direction that people's courts must always adhere to. People's courts at all levels must correctly understand and handle the relationship between adjudication work and the overall work of the Party and the state, be good at observing the situation from a political and overall perspective, determine the focus of adjudication work for each period based on the central deployment, propose correct countermeasures and measures and implement them effectively; must correctly understand and handle the relationship between learning theory and implementing the law, adhere to guiding adjudication practice with Deng Xiaoping's theory on democracy and legal system construction; must correctly understand and handle the relationship between implementing the law and implementing policies, and be adept at correctly applying the law to adjudicate cases under the guidance of the Party's line, principles, policies, and the general standard of "three favorables."

Fifth, the leadership of the Party must be relied upon, and supervision by the People's Congress must be accepted. In accordance with the Constitution and laws, people's courts occupy the position of final adjudication of social contradictions and dispute cases. Since many cases accepted by people's courts involve issues arising from economic transition and reform and development, and many cases reflect deep-seated institutional contradictions, the outcomes of these cases are of great significance for promoting reform and opening up, ensuring economic development, and maintaining social stability. They must rely on the leadership and coordination of the Party committee, supervision and support from the People's Congress, and cooperation from relevant government departments to be properly resolved in accordance with the law. The law enforcement environment and conditions must also be further improved by relying on the leadership of the Party, supervision of the People's Congress, and support from the government. Only by consciously accepting the leadership of the Party and the supervision of the People's Congress can the adjudication and enforcement work of people's courts develop smoothly in the correct direction.

III. Focus and Measures of Adjudication Work in Serving Economic Development

The main tasks set by the Fourth Plenary Session of the 15th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Economic Work Conference are closely related to the adjudication work of people's courts. When people's courts carry out adjudication work closely around these main tasks, they are serving the overall work of the Party and the state. In the coming period, people's courts at all levels should strengthen adjudication work in the following aspects.

(A) Fully leverage adjudication functions to ensure the smooth progress of state-owned enterprise reform and promote the common development of a multi-ownership economy with public ownership as the mainstay

1. Crack down on all types of crimes that disrupt the economic order in accordance with the law. We must resolutely punish crimes such as smuggling, producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy products, infringing on enterprise intellectual property rights and trade secrets, sanction various unfair competition behaviors, and maintain the normal economic order necessary for the reform and development of state-owned enterprises. We must severely crack down on crimes of looting, stealing, destroying, or intentionally damaging production materials and equipment of state-owned enterprises, especially group theft crimes targeting state-owned enterprises, to protect state-owned enterprise assets. In conjunction with the anti-corruption struggle, we must strictly punish crimes of embezzlement, misappropriation, fraud, and encroachment on state-owned enterprise funds in accordance with the law, to protect state-owned assets from infringement. We must severely crack down on crimes of retaliatory killing or injuring of state-owned enterprise leaders, employees, or other crimes infringing on the personal rights of state-owned enterprise leaders and employees, to create a good public security environment for the production and operation of state-owned enterprises. When adjudicating these criminal cases, we must both handle major and important cases well and strictly distinguish the boundary between crime and non-crime; while strictly punishing criminals in accordance with the law, we must also protect enterprise workers who dare to reform and support their lawful operations; while adhering to criminal sanctions, we must also do a good job in recovering and returning stolen money and property, reducing the property losses of state-owned enterprises.

2. Regulate various economic, civil, and administrative relationships in accordance with the law. We must properly adjudicate cases arising from enterprise reorganization, association, merger, leasing, contracting, equity participation, holding, and the relaxation and invigoration of small and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, ensuring the smooth completion of the strategic reorganization of state-owned enterprises. For cases involving the merger, bankruptcy, and closure of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, we must handle them properly in strict accordance with relevant laws, policies, and judicial interpretations; for cases of asset restructuring such as enterprise mergers and acquisitions involving changes in property rights, we must strictly regulate asset appraisal in accordance with the law, both to prevent the loss of state-owned assets and to prevent evasion of bank debts and national taxes, while also promoting capital increase and debt reduction and asset restructuring. We must properly adjudicate cases arising from the establishment and improvement of the modern enterprise system in state-owned enterprises, protect the autonomy of enterprise operations and state management of state-owned assets in accordance with the law. We must properly adjudicate cases involving the equity, creditor's rights, and debts of state-owned enterprises, ensure and promote the increase of direct investment and financing by enterprises, maintain the control of the state-owned economy and the legitimate rights and interests of banks and other creditors. We must pay attention to the adjudication of labor and social security cases, protect the legitimate rights and interests of workers in accordance with the law, promote the reform of the labor system, and support enterprises in strengthening and improving management. We must properly adjudicate administrative cases involving state-owned enterprises, resolutely stop various arbitrary charges, fines, apportionments, and other acts harmful to the legitimate rights and interests of enterprises, while supporting state administrative organs in exercising their administrative powers according to law. For cases involving major projects and key engineering constructions of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises with large disputes and significant impact on production development, we must file and adjudicate them quickly and conclude them in a timely manner. When discovering irregular or illegal business activities of enterprises during the adjudication of cases, we must actively put forward judicial suggestions.

3. Protect the legitimate rights and interests of all litigation subjects equally in accordance with the law, and promote the healthy development of the market economy. The basic economic system of the primary stage of socialism in China is the common development of a multi-ownership economy with public ownership as the mainstay. The diversification of public ownership forms and the common development of multiple economic sectors are needs of the socialist market economy development, needs for further emancipating and developing the productive forces, and also major tasks of the economic system reform. To this end, legal guarantees and legal services must be provided according to law. While ensuring the reform and development of state-owned enterprises in accordance with the law, people's courts must strictly adhere to the principle of fairness in their adjudication and enforcement work. Whether they are market entities of public ownership or non-public ownership, they must be treated equally in the application of the law. Only in this way can the market economic order be maintained in accordance with the law and the healthy development of the socialist market economy be promoted.

(B) Provide judicial guarantees for agricultural structural adjustment and rural economic development

1. Properly adjudicate cases of agricultural contract disputes. The market-oriented agricultural structural adjustment involves changes in planting methods, areas, varieties, and processing depth, which will inevitably lead to some disputes due to changes in the content of some rural contract contracts. When handling these cases, people's courts must first resolutely implement the spirit of the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Agriculture and Rural Work" adopted by the Third Plenary Session of the 15th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, implement the policy of "granting farmers long-term and protected land use rights," and effectively protect farmers' land contract rights, production autonomy, and management income rights. Second, they must actively accept and handle such cases in accordance with the "Decision on Several Issues Concerning the Adjudication of Agricultural Contract Dispute Cases (Trial)" issued by the Supreme People's Court. Third, in accordance with the requirements for adjusting the agricultural structure determined by the Central Economic Work Conference, when adjudicating relevant cases, they must guide farmers to consciously fulfill the adjustment tasks in accordance with the law. They must strictly adjudicate cases arising from acts such as arbitrarily increasing land contract fees, tearing up contracts, multiple contracting of one piece of land, repossessing land for high-priced contracting, shortening the contract period, etc., in accordance with the law, and resolutely correct various illegal acts.

2. Properly adjudicate cases of purchase and sale contract disputes for agricultural and sideline products. They must maintain the legal effect of contracts, sanction breaches of contract and other acts infringing on the legitimate rights and interests of farmers in accordance with the law. Especially when adjudicating cases involving grain circulation, they must resolutely ensure the implementation of the three policies established by the central government: purchasing surplus grain from farmers at protective prices with open purchases, selling grain at a profit by grain storage and purchase enterprises, and closed operation of grain purchase funds, resolutely sanction various illegal acts that interfere with and undermine these three policies, and ensure the smooth progress of the grain circulation system reform.

3. Crack down on and sanction crimes that damage agricultural facilities and acts that infringe on farmers' interests in accordance with the law. They must severely crack down on criminal activities that damage agricultural equipment and agricultural infrastructure; promptly adjudicate cases of producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and other acts that harm farmers, severely sanction the producers and sellers involved in accordance with the law, and if a crime is constituted, pursue criminal liability in accordance with the law; through adjudication activities, resolutely stop various types of illegal acts such as arbitrary charges, fines, and apportionments under various names, reduce the burden on farmers in accordance with the law, and provide a good judicial environment for the implementation of the rural "tax and fee reform." At the same time, by adjudicating cases involving agriculture, they must ensure the implementation of the principle of "who invests, who owns, who manages, and who benefits," protecting the enthusiasm of collectives and farmers in building and operating agricultural infrastructure in various forms.

(C) Regulate the financial order in accordance with the law, prevent and resolve financial risks, and ensure the stable operation of the national economy

They must severely crack down on illegal fundraising, financial fraud, and crimes using intelligent means such as computer networks against banks and other financial institutions. In accordance with the central government's deployment to rectify and regulate the financial order, they must properly adjudicate loan dispute cases. They must effectively implement the revised Criminal Law, apply the newly added charges according to law, and resolutely crack down on various crimes that disrupt and undermine the order of the financial market and financial accounting management. When adjudicating financial dispute cases, they must strictly examine and determine the responsibilities of both lenders and borrowers, resolutely stop attempts to evade or eliminate debts through litigation or other means that circumvent the law, and maintain the credit order. The conversion of enterprise debts into equity is both an important means to promote enterprise turnaround and structural adjustment and an important measure to reduce the non-performing assets of banks. When adjudicating such cases, people's courts must adhere to standards and carefully review, and if there is fraud or evasion of debts, pursue the legal liability of the parties and responsible persons. According to the relevant policies and regulations of the central government and the State Council, they must prudently handle cases involving rural cooperative foundations. For disputes where rural cooperative foundations are debtors and disputes between rural cooperative foundations and farmers, the liquidation department should generally handle them first in accordance with relevant national policies.

(D) Protect intellectual property rights in accordance with the law, and provide effective judicial guarantees for technological innovation and the full implementation of the strategy of revitalizing the country through science and education

1. Promote scientific and technological progress in accordance with the law, and accelerate the promotion and application of scientific and technological achievements. Whether it is a legal person of an enterprise, a state organ, an institution, a social organization, or other organization, as long as it has scientific research capabilities or possesses scientific and technological achievements, it can enter into a technology contract. Similarly, citizens are not limited by their occupation, position, age, etc., as long as they have the ability to perform the technology contract, they can enter into a technology contract. When adjudicating technology contract dispute cases, as long as the parties to the contract have the ability to perform, the contract cannot be deemed invalid on the grounds of the unsuitability of the contract subject. For contracts that hinder technological progress, they must be deemed invalid according to law. At the same time, the illegal monopoly of technology must be prevented according to law. By adjudicating cases, protect the enthusiasm of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations for scientific research and invention creation.

2. Legally protect the legitimate technical rights and interests of the parties. In adjudicating the rights and interests of parties in technology contract disputes, the people's courts shall protect both their property rights and their personal rights according to law. For individuals who have completed job-related technological achievements, their rights to sign on relevant technological achievement documents and to obtain honorary certificates and rewards shall be protected according to law; for parties who agree to assign patent and non-patent technology rights in accordance with the principle of equality and mutual benefit, such agreements shall be protected according to law.

3. Legally sanction all types of intellectual property infringement acts. Those who infringe upon patent rights, trademark rights, copyrights, invention rights, trade secrets, etc., thereby seriously disrupting the technology market and causing losses to intellectual property right holders, shall be seriously sanctioned according to law; where the conduct constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law. To strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights, the people's courts shall boldly explore and innovate in various aspects including the adjudication organization for intellectual property cases, case jurisdiction, methods of evidence presentation, and case enforcement, so as to improve the level of intellectual property adjudication work.

(V) Carry out all preparatory work and use judicial means to ensure the implementation of the Western Development Strategy

1. Courts in the western region shall strengthen their own construction organizationally and materially. With the implementation of the Western Development Strategy, the state will introduce new policies regarding funds, projects, and personnel. As the flow of people, funds, goods and economic activities increase, various types of cases filed in courts will rise. The people's courts in the western region and relevant regions shall make corresponding preparations. First, adopt various forms to strengthen the training of adjudication personnel in western region courts, further improving their political and professional quality; second, in conjunction with the implementation of the cadre exchange system, the Supreme People's Court shall, together with relevant state departments, formulate as soon as possible a counterpart exchange method for court cadres between the eastern and western regions. Eastern provinces and municipalities shall each year systematically select a certain number of adjudication backbones to work and train in western region courts; western region courts shall also select some young judges to study and improve in eastern region courts before returning to their original adjudication posts. Third, adopt various forms to strengthen the material equipment construction of western region courts. The Supreme People's Court will consult with relevant departments to support the equipment construction of poor western region courts.

2. Vigorously strengthen the adjudication capacity of courts in the western region to ensure the proper handling of all types of cases related to the Great Western Development. After the launch of the Western Development, on the one hand, new types of cases that previously occurred more frequently in the eastern region will gradually appear in the western region; on the other hand, as the western region becomes a hotspot for Chinese and foreign investment, cases involving both eastern and western regions and foreign-related cases will increase. Handling these cases well and promoting the Western Development will become an important common task for courts in both the eastern and western regions. For cases involving both regions, eastern and western courts shall strengthen the exchange of relevant information to ensure timely and fair adjudication according to law. Eastern courts shall set an example in this regard. The ability to adjudicate foreign-related cases shall be enhanced. In the process of counterpart support for western region courts, eastern courts shall send personnel to help western region courts establish strong collegiate panels for foreign-related cases, and impart trial experience and provide relevant cases. In adjudication work, the unification of implementing laws and implementing policies shall be adhered to. For civil and economic dispute cases involving the Western Development, if the law has clear provisions, they shall be strictly adjudicated according to law; if neither the law nor policies have provisions, they shall be properly handled in accordance with the spirit of the "three favorables" principle. We must understand the overall situation and take the overall situation into consideration. For cases that have a significant impact on the Western Development, group action cases, etc., they must be handled promptly and properly, and must not, due to improper case handling, affect the progress of the Western Development or social stability.

IV. Strengthen the adjudication of foreign-related cases

The gradual advancement of China's opening-up pattern from coastal areas to the vast central and western regions, as well as the changes and impacts after China's accession to the WTO, will place higher and newer demands on the foreign-related adjudication work of the people's courts. In this regard, full preparations must be made and feasible countermeasures adopted.

(1) Broaden horizons and establish a global awareness in foreign-related adjudication

In foreign-related adjudication work, a global awareness must be established, with a broad world vision. Establishing a global awareness requires that in our adjudication activities, we not only enforce the law strictly, but also strive for good results of law enforcement. Foreign-related adjudication has both domestic and international impact; it has both legal effects and social effects. Having a broad world vision requires us to analyze issues using Marxist standpoints, viewpoints, and methods, correctly understand the significant meaning and role of the people's courts doing a good job in foreign-related adjudication for China's further opening-up, and correctly understand the necessity and urgency of adhering to the judicial concept of equal subject status in foreign-related adjudication. After China's accession to the WTO, it must both enjoy rights and assume and fulfill corresponding obligations. In accordance with the principle of equality and mutual benefit generally applicable in international economic exchanges, foreign enterprises engaged in economic activities or participating in litigation in China shall be treated equally with domestic enterprises and organizations according to law.

(2) Strengthen study and accurately apply international trade legal norms

International legal norms that the Chinese government has acceded to or recognized, except for declared reservations, whether multilateral or bilateral treaties or agreements, are the legal basis for the people's courts to adjudicate relevant foreign-related cases. The World Trade Organization is the most important forum in today's world for formulating international trade rules and resolving multilateral trade disputes. Its series of resolutions, regulations, procedures, and methods formulated over the years, including mechanisms of reciprocity and mutual restraint, have become internationally accepted trade rules. We must step up research on these international trade legal norms, become familiar with them as soon as possible, and be able to apply them skillfully in adjudication practice.

Foreign-related adjudication is mainly concentrated in the civil and commercial fields. Civil and commercial disputes are primarily conflicts of interest between the parties. When the people's courts adjudicate these cases, they should start from resolving the imbalance of interests between the parties, properly resolve disputes, and exercise great caution in adopting punitive measures. Judges engaged in foreign-related adjudication must have both the qualities of a legal professional and the vision of a political figure; they must have the ability to correctly apply the law and also possess the breadth of mind to govern the country according to law and have a global perspective.

(3) Conduct in-depth research and enhance foresight in foreign-related adjudication

In response to the new situation after China's accession to the WTO, the people's courts must pay attention to grasping trends, conduct in-depth research on various new situations and changes, and enhance the predictability of foreign-related adjudication. For example, how much impact and role will the Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights, formulated by the WTO and its predecessor GATT, have on China's future adjudication of foreign-related intellectual property disputes? We should start research as early as possible. Foreign enterprises and multinational corporations will enter China's market more frequently. While protecting their legitimate rights and interests according to law, there may also be technology and market monopolies and unfair competition. We should make corresponding judicial preparations. Foreign-related bankruptcy cases have already occurred in China. In adjudicating foreign-related bankruptcy cases, although overall equal protection has been provided to both Chinese and foreign creditors, there are still many issues, including the composition of the liquidation committee, creditor meeting procedures, and asset evaluation, where experience is lacking. Practice and research must be intensified. The people's courts must never, due to lagging preparatory work, cause significant losses to national interests or damage the international image of China's judicial fairness.

V. Key Points and Measures for Enforcement Work to Serve Economic Development

Doing a good job in enforcement work is an important part of the people's courts providing legal guarantees and services for economic development. In implementing the various major tasks determined by the Fourth Plenary Session of the Fifteenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Economic Work Conference, we must further fully implement Document No. 11 (1999) of the Central Committee, deepen reforms, improve measures, face difficulties, and strive to make court enforcement work play a greater role in ensuring and serving economic construction.

(1) Handling enforcement cases involving state-owned enterprises is the focus of serving economic development

For enforcement cases involving state-owned enterprises, we must both adhere to strict law enforcement and pay attention to enforcement methods and results. The thinking on enforcement work should shift from single compulsory enforcement to a combination of various enforcement methods. For the enforcement of claims involving state-owned enterprises, efforts should be strengthened to ensure the realization of state-owned enterprise claims according to law. For the enforcement of debts involving state-owned enterprises, coordination and cooperation with relevant departments should be strengthened based on law and policy, especially seizing the opportunity when state-owned commercial banks establish financial asset management companies, strip non-performing loans, and hand over such assets to the company for management and operation, to resolve according to law the financial claims against state-owned enterprises that have been lodged in court enforcement procedures. If the products of the person subject to enforcement have high technological content, high added value, market demand, and can generate cash flow, but are unable to expand production due to debt entanglements and lack of financing, after properly communicating with the person applying for enforcement, methods such as transferring intangible assets or using labor to offset debts may be adopted to enable the enterprise subject to enforcement to regain vitality. If the products of the person subject to enforcement have a certain market, conform to industrial policy, and have development potential, the method of "releasing water to raise fish" may be adopted: using certain assets as collateral, suspend enforcement, and recover the debt after the enterprise's operations improve. If the person subject to enforcement goes bankrupt or is closed, enforcement of its claims should be intensified, bankruptcy expenses reduced, and the satisfaction rate increased as much as possible to reduce creditor losses.

While handling enforcement cases involving state-owned enterprises, the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of all other civil subjects must also be ensured to enhance the overall efficiency of the national economy.

(2) Resolutely resist and overcome local and departmental protectionism is an important condition for doing a good job in enforcement work and serving economic construction

Local and departmental protectionism is an important cause of "difficulty in enforcement" and a major obstacle to strict law enforcement. It must be resolutely resisted and overcome. The people's court, as a state judicial organ, must never engage in local or departmental protectionism. We must resolutely oppose the tendency of judicial power being localized. For regulations or documents that are contrary to the law and set obstacles for court enforcement, suggestions should be promptly made to the Party committee, People's Congress, and government for revocation or abolition. For those that ignore the matter, the superior Party committee and superior people's court should be promptly reported, up to the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission and the Supreme People's Court. Typical examples of local and departmental protectionism should be promptly provided to discipline inspection and supervision organs for investigation and handling.

(3) Implementing unified management and coordination of enforcement work is a mechanism guarantee for doing a good job in enforcement and serving economic construction

People's courts at all levels must take the overall situation into account, resolutely eliminate interference, and promptly establish and improve an enforcement work mechanism with unified management and coordination by the Higher People's Court. Qualified enforcement personnel must be strictly allocated in accordance with relevant document requirements, especially the selection and strengthening of the leaders of enforcement institutions, particularly those of Higher People's Courts. Special funds and case-handling expenses should be actively sought, and at the same time, difficulties should be overcome to allocate part of the existing budget to equip enforcement divisions with necessary means of transportation, communication tools, and police equipment to meet the actual needs of enforcement work.

(4) Adhering to law-based, fair, and civilized enforcement is the fundamental requirement for doing a good job in enforcement and serving economic construction

Judicial fairness requires not only procedural fairness and substantive fairness in the trial process, but also procedural fairness and substantive fairness in the enforcement process. We must pursue enforcement fairness as vigorously as we pursue judgment fairness, and ensure transparency in enforcement. Enforcement must be carried out civilly in strict accordance with the procedures stipulated in procedural law, and the property rights and interests of the parties must be correctly disposed of in strict accordance with the provisions of substantive law. Through the effective enforcement of cases, the rights and obligations determined by the judgment documents shall be realized, obstructions in social economic relations shall be timely removed, the legitimate rights and interests of the parties shall be protected according to law, and the state's judicial authority shall be resolutely upheld.

Enforcement personnel of people's courts at all levels must strictly observe all enforcement disciplines, convince people by law and by reason, so that enforcement work gains the understanding and support of the broad masses, including the persons subject to enforcement.

VI. Strengthen Supervision, Guidance, and Judicial Interpretation Work

To give full play to the adjudication function of the people's courts and actively and effectively ensure the implementation of the central government's major deployments and decisions on economic development, supervision and guidance over adjudication and enforcement work must be vigorously strengthened, and judicial interpretation work must be done well.

(1) Change work style, strict systems, and improve the level of supervision and guidance

The Supreme People's Court over local people's courts and special people's courts, and higher people's courts over lower people's courts, shall increase the intensity of supervision and guidance in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution and laws. For criminal cases, the focus of supervision should be on distinguishing crime from non-crime; for civil and economic cases, the focus should be on determining the assumption of civil liability. For procedural unfairness, substantive unfairness, and enforcement unfairness, higher people's courts must resolutely correct them according to law. Higher people's courts shall list the resolution of new situations, new issues, and the application of law in new types of cases encountered by lower people's courts in their adjudication and enforcement work as important content of supervision and guidance.

The policy of strengthening grassroots work must be unswervingly and persistently implemented. People's courts at and above the intermediate level must truly change their work style, often go to grassroots people's courts for investigation and research, and do everything possible to consolidate the foundation of court work. China has a vast territory, a large population, unbalanced development, and great differences in conditions across regions. In supervising and guiding court work, the enthusiasm and functional role of each Higher People's Court must be fully utilized. In the future, when the Supreme People's Court formulates important judicial interpretations and normative documents, it shall, as needed, organize relevant Higher People's Courts to conduct joint research and drafting. Higher People's Courts shall continue to adopt various effective forms to vigorously strengthen adjudication supervision and comprehensive business guidance over courts within their jurisdiction.

(2) Strengthen judicial interpretation work to ensure the correct implementation of laws

The comprehensive implementation of the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the Fifteenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Economic Work Conference will surely create a new situation for China's reform, opening-up, and modernization efforts. In view of the fact that social legal relations are constantly changing and often cannot be fully covered by the content of current laws, the Supreme People's Court shall fully utilize the power of judicial interpretation granted by law, and on the basis of strengthening investigation and research, improve the timeliness and applicability of judicial interpretations, so that the people's courts can make full use of existing legal resources to provide timely and effective services for economic development.

We must step up research on legal application issues urgently needed to be addressed after joining the WTO, such as anti-dumping, anti-monopoly disputes, and the application of laws and regulations on investment, finance, insurance, securities, intellectual property, and consumer rights protection. All these require efforts in judicial interpretation. In response to new situations and new issues encountered in the implementation of laws such as the Criminal Law and the Contract Law, we must strengthen criminal, civil, and economic judicial interpretation work. To meet the needs of deepening reforms in criminal, civil, economic, and administrative adjudication methods, as well as enforcement work reforms, we must strengthen judicial interpretation of procedural laws.

VII. Strengthen the Construction of the People's Court Team

The key to providing high-quality and efficient judicial guarantees and legal services for economic development lies in people, lies in the team. This year and in the coming period, we must earnestly implement the "Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts," closely focus on the needs of economic development for court work, and focus on the following tasks in team construction:

First, focus on cultivating a high-quality judge team and reform the personnel system. Strictly control the "import," unblock the "export," and introduce a competition and incentive mechanism. Recruitment must go through strict written examinations, interviews, and reviews, selecting the best; for initial appointment of judges or promotion to a higher level of judge, strict assessment must also be conducted, with promotion based on merit. Vigorously promote the reform of selecting and appointing presiding judges and sole judges, and implement corresponding treatment for the selected excellent talents. Personnel who are not suited to adjudication work requirements shall undergo training or be reassigned to auxiliary work. Personnel of low quality and poor conduct shall be cleaned out according to relevant regulations; on the premise of conducive to giving full play to adjudication professional expertise, a rotation and exchange system shall be implemented; gradually implement the system of selecting judges of higher people's courts from judges of lower people's courts and recruiting high-quality judges from society.

Second, strengthen the judge self-discipline mechanism, and enhance ideological and political work and management supervision. Judges are a special group that must rely on a high degree of self-discipline. They should have higher standards in moral conduct and academic ability. Cultivating a large number of high-quality judges with noble character is the basic guarantee for establishing judicial authority and ensuring judicial fairness. The court's ideological and political work and management supervision must start from this high starting point. To this end, continue to implement the policy of strict governance of the court, strictly implement the "Measures for Investigating Liability for Illegal Adjudication by Adjudication Personnel of the People's Courts (Trial)" and the "Measures for Disciplinary Sanctions in Adjudication of the People's Courts (Trial)," effectively implement the responsibility system for building a clean Party and government, and thoroughly investigate and seriously deal with any cases of perversion of justice and violations of adjudication discipline; further improve the systems and measures for courts to accept supervision by the People's Congress, democratic supervision by the CPPCC, legal supervision by the procuratorial organs, and social supervision by news media and the public, and broaden channels for actively accepting supervision. Improve the connection between external supervision and internal supervision, use external supervision to initiate internal supervision and promote internal supervision. While inheriting and carrying forward fine traditions, earnestly study the characteristics and laws of ideological and political work in people's courts under the new situation, actively open up new avenues, explore new methods, closely combine strict management and strict supervision of judges with giving full play to political advantages and strengthening ideological and political work, and through strengthening the study of the Party's basic theory, basic line, and basic policies, carrying out activities to learn from heroic models and various forms of competing to be advanced, form among judges a value pursuit of self-education, self-discipline, and conscious improvement, solve the fundamental issues of for whom to enforce the law, for whom to serve, and for whom to wield power, so as to create a judge team with noble professional ethics, strict self-discipline ability, and a high level of judicial expertise.

Third, do a good job in judge education and training, and prepare the knowledge needed to serve economic development. Deepening the reform of state-owned enterprises and rural reform, implementing the Western Development Strategy, and joining the WTO have placed urgent and heavy tasks on court education and training work. People's courts at all levels must be resolute in attitude, quick in action, and start work as early as possible. Higher and intermediate people's courts must regard cultivating judges who understand market economy knowledge and are familiar with foreign-related laws as a major task, and promptly carry out training in foreign-related civil and commercial laws and foreign language skills. Comprehensively promote the reform of education and training work in people's courts, and promptly cultivate a group of high-quality adjudication business leaders and expert judges.

Fourth, seize the key and do a good job in building the leadership teams of people's courts at all levels. The key to strengthening team construction is to do a good job in building the leadership teams of people's courts at all levels. Take the "Three Stresses" education and the "look back" as an opportunity to effectively solve prominent problems in Party spirit and Party conduct existing in court leaders and leadership teams, implement rectification measures, and build the leadership teams of people's courts at all levels well. Leading cadres of people's courts at all levels must lead by example, be strict with themselves, play a leading role, and use a strong leadership team to bring out a people's court team with firm politics, professional proficiency, fairness and integrity, excellent work style, and strict discipline, meet new challenges with a brand-new spirit, and make due contributions to the realization of the major tasks arranged by the Fourth Plenary Session of the Fifteenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Economic Work Conference.

March 1, 2000
